# Page 1
SCHEDULE A
(Form 1040)
Itemized Deductions
- 1: Medical and dental expenses
- 5a: State and local income taxes or general sales taxes
- 5e: Enter the smaller of line 5d or $40,000
- 8a: Home mortgage interest and points reported to you on Form 1098
- 11: Gifts by cash or check
- 17: Add the amounts in the far right column for lines 4 through 16
